title: Incoming page differentials vanish modulo successor boundaries
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $F$ a decreasing filtration [def-sp-filtration], $r\ge1$, and $D$ differential data on the concrete quotient page [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]. Fix $i=(p,q)$ and $n=p+q$. Let $Z_r,B_{r+1}$ be the graded subobjects [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and suppose $h:B_{r+1}^{p,q}\le Z_r^{p,q}$. For any object $Q$ and morphism $a:E_r^{p,q}\to Q$ satisfying $\mathrm{incl}_h\,\pi_r\,a=0$, the incoming differential satisfies $D.d(\mathrm{prev}(i),i)\,a=0$. Here $\pi_r:Z_r^{p,q}\to E_r^{p,q}$ is the concrete cokernel projection and $\mathrm{prev}(i)=(p-r,q+r-1)$.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed boundary formula and differential formula preceding lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: At the preceding bidegree (p-r,q+r-1), total degree n-1, the map from unquotiented r-cycle representatives to graded r-cycles is epic: graded cycles are the projected image of the sum of those representatives and F^(p-r+1), and that extra summand is killed by the graded projection. Composing with the cokernel projection gives an epimorphism onto the source page. One may pull back this epimorphism to lift generalized page classes without any projectivity assumption.

proof.text: For a lifted representative x in F^(p-r) K^(n-1), the r-cycle condition puts dx in F^p K^n. Thus dx lies in F^p intersect d(F^(p-r)), whose projected image is B_(r+1). Also d(dx)=0, so its graded class lies in Z_r. The inclusion h agrees with this class in Z_r because the subobject arrows are monic. Lift through the image factorization defining B_(r+1) after an epimorphic pullback if needed.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed boundary formula and differential formula preceding lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Apply D.on_representatives to x and dx: the incoming differential on the page class of x is the page class of dx. Postcomposing with a gives zero by the hypothesis on B_(r+1). Cancel the epimorphic covers from the first two steps to obtain the asserted zero composite.

    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ)
    (hB : F.complexBoundaries pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) (r + 1) ≤
      F.complexCycles pq.1 (pq.1 + pq.2) r)
    (Q : C) (q : filteredComplexPageObject K F r pq ⟶ Q)
    (hq : Subobject.ofLE _ _ hB ≫ filteredComplexPageπ K F r pq ≫ q = 0) :
    D.d ((ComplexShape.up' (r, 1 - r)).prev pq) pq ≫ q = 0
